description: Hand-written command sequences for the existing Terminal-Bench task 'hello-world' (create /app/hello.txt containing 'Hello, world!'). Not LLM-generated. Rollouts are ordered so that, with snapshots after every stateful command, they exercise: uncached run, identical cached run, divergent suffixes restored from the same snapshot, and a state-equivalent rewrite.

rollouts.name: solve
rollouts.purpose: Uncached run: every command executes; test should pass.

rollouts.name: solve-again
rollouts.purpose: Identical history: every step and the test result should be cache hits.

rollouts.name: wrong-content
rollouts.purpose: Shares step 0, then diverges: resumes from the step-0 snapshot; test should fail.

rollouts.name: inspect-prefix
rollouts.purpose: Restores the same step-0 snapshot a second time. 'pwd' checks that cwd survived the snapshot; 'ls /app' must not show hello.txt, which earlier rollouts wrote only after step 0 (snapshot not mutated).

rollouts.name: equivalent-rewrite
rollouts.purpose: Reaches the same files as 'solve' via a differently written command. Exact-match caching misses step 1; this pair is a candidate for semantic merging and for environment comparison, which this repo does not decide.
